entries.title: 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED with limit: 0 or Phantom Exhaustion
symptoms: UI meter shows 95-99% quota remaining, yet requests immediately fail with 429.
API error payload reports `limit: 0` on a paid project or newly upgraded Pro/Ultra account.
Switching between OAuth login and `GEMINI_API_KEY` triggers sudden rate-limit errors.
entries.root_cause: Entitlement or billing project desync: rate limits apply per GCP project (not per API key), so an unbilled project (`limit: 0`), Tier 1 10-min $10 spend cap, or an accidental `GEMINI_API_KEY` env override causes immediate 429s.
entries.root_cause_zh: 权益或计费项目失步：Gemini API 限流按 GCP Project（而非单个 API Key）计算。未绑定计费的项目（limit: 0）、Tier 1 的 10 分钟 $10 消费速率上限，或 Shell 中残留的 GEMINI_API_KEY 覆盖了 OAuth 订阅，都会触发假性 429。
steps: Check whether `GEMINI_API_KEY` or `GOOGLE_API_KEY` is accidentally exported in your shell and overriding OAuth.
Inspect the 429 JSON `RetryInfo` and `quotaMetric`: if `limit: 0`, your selected GCP project lacks active billing or Free Tier eligibility.
In Antigravity / Gemini CLI, run Reset Onboarding or re-link the active paid Google Cloud billing project (verify Tier 1/2/3 spend cap).
Run `npx agycraft-mcp doctor` to verify env conflicts without exposing secret values.
steps_zh: 检查 Shell 是否意外导出了 GEMINI_API_KEY 或 GOOGLE_API_KEY，导致覆盖了 OAuth 订阅额度。
检查 429 载荷中的 RetryInfo 与 quotaMetric：若显示 limit: 0，说明当前 GCP 项目未启用有效计费或该区域无 Free 资格。
在 Antigravity / Gemini CLI 中执行 Reset Onboarding 或重新绑定已开启计费的 GCP 项目（核对 Tier 1 $10/10分钟消费上限）。
运行 `npx agycraft-mcp doctor` 在不泄露密钥值的前提下排查环境变量冲突。

commands.label: Check env conflict (boolean only, never prints values)
Temporarily unset API key override to use OAuth plan

dont_dos: Do NOT spam rapid retries in a loop — repeated 429 bursts trigger abuse cooldowns.
Do NOT paste OAuth tokens or API keys into public issues or third-party quota checkers.
dont_dos_zh: 严禁死循环狂点重试，高频 429 突发请求会触发风控冷却。
严禁将 OAuth Token 或 API Key 粘贴到公开 Issue 或第三方查额度网站。

history.note: Verified per-project rate limiting and 10-min spend caps against aistudio.google.com/docs/rate-limits.

entries.title: Shared 5h Rolling Window or 7-Day Weekly Cap Reached
entries.title_zh: 5 小时滚动窗口或 7 天周共享配额上限触顶
symptoms: Heavy Neon or Carbon agent loops exhaust quota early in the 5h window.
Daily PT midnight passes, yet Antigravity still blocks frontier models due to the 7-day rolling weekly cap.
Single long uncompacted session burns tens of millions of uncached input tokens.
entries.root_cause: True shared-bucket exhaustion across the 5-hour rolling window or 7-day weekly ceiling. Note that implicit full-request KV caching requires >= 4,096 base tokens AND >= 2,050 new tokens added per multi-turn loop.
entries.root_cause_zh: 5 小时滚动窗口或 7 天周共享桶真实耗尽。常见诱因包括用 Neon/Carbon 做机械改写、长会话未及时 /compact，或破坏了 4,096 Token 隐式缓存前缀（多轮需新增 >= 2,050 Token 才能完整缓存上一轮）。
steps: Audit local 5h/7d burn and cache-hit warnings with `agycraft-mcp` (`analyze_token_usage` + `get_saving_recommendations`).
Run `/compact` immediately or switch mid-turn (AGY v2.35.2+) from Neon to Hydrogen.
Check `/usage` and `/credits` in Antigravity CLI to see whether AI Credit overages are set to `Never` or `Always`.
Add `.geminiignore` to exclude `node_modules`, build outputs, and lockfiles from context ingestion.
steps_zh: 通过 `agycraft-mcp`（`analyze_token_usage` + `get_saving_recommendations`）排查本机 5h/7d 消耗与缓存失效原因。
立即执行 `/compact` 压缩上下文，或利用 AGY v2.35.2+ 在轮次中将 Neon 切换为 Hydrogen。
在 AGY CLI 中运行 `/usage` 与 `/credits` 查看配额与 AI Credits 超额策略（Never / Always）。
维护 `.geminiignore` 排除 `node_modules`、构建产物与锁文件。

commands.label: Run local quota & context hygiene check
Create a minimal .geminiignore to stop context bloat

dont_dos: Do NOT rotate multiple personal accounts or use gray-market proxy relays (violates Google ToS).
Do NOT leave an agent stuck in a failing test loop on Neon or Carbon overnight.
dont_dos_zh: 严禁多账号轮换或接入灰色反代中转（违反 Google 服务条款并有封号风险）。
严禁让 Neon/Carbon 在报错测试死循环中无人值守空转。

history.note: Added AGY v2.35.2 mid-turn switch and 2,050-token multi-turn cache rule.

entries.title: 401 / 403 Permission Denied & OAuth / Project Mismatch
entries.title_zh: 401 / 403 鉴权拒绝与 OAuth / GCP 项目失步
symptoms: CLI or IDE throws `403 Permission Denied` or `cloudaicompanion...denied` after switching accounts.
`ACCESS_TOKEN_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED` when mixing Application Default Credentials with Consumer API endpoints.
Workspace/Enterprise admin account fails without `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` set.
entries.root_cause: Stale OAuth grant, mismatched `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT`, or mixing an AI Studio API key with Vertex/ADC OAuth credentials.
entries.root_cause_zh: 本地 OAuth 授权缓存过期、GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT 绑定错位，或混用了 AI Studio API Key 与 Vertex/ADC OAuth 凭证。
steps: Revoke the stale third-party/CLI app grant at `https://myaccount.google.com/connections` if switching Google accounts.
Clear local Gemini CLI / gcloud cached credentials (never print token contents).
Explicitly export `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` when using Vertex AI or Workspace-managed seats.
Re-authenticate cleanly via `gcloud auth application-default login` or the built-in CLI login flow.
steps_zh: 若切换过 Google 账号，先前往 `https://myaccount.google.com/connections` 移除旧授权。
清理本机 Gemini CLI / gcloud 缓存凭证（严禁打印或外传凭证内容）。
使用 Vertex AI 或 Workspace 企业席位时，显式导出 `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT`。
重新执行 `gcloud auth application-default login` 或 CLI 内置登录流程。

commands.label: Set explicit Google Cloud Project ID

entries.verify_command: gcloud config get-value project && npx agycraft-mcp doctor
dont_dos: Do NOT inspect, copy, or share `~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json` or `~/.config/gcloud/` contents.
Do NOT mix `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true` with a personal AI Studio `GEMINI_API_KEY`.
dont_dos_zh: 严禁读取、复制或分享 `~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json` 或 `~/.config/gcloud/` 内的凭证文件。
严禁将 `GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI=true` 与个人 AI Studio API Key 混用。

history.note: Verified clean reset sequence for OAuth/ADC and GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT.

entries.title: 503 No Capacity, 504 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED & Agent Stall
entries.title_zh: 503 容量不足、504 请求超时与 Agent 卡死
symptoms: Requests fail with `503 UNAVAILABLE` or `The model is overloaded` during peak US/EU hours.
Long prompt with `high`/`xhigh` Thinking budget hangs until `504 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`.
Antigravity agent stalls on feature-flag or stream handshake (`antigravity-unleash.goog` timeout).
entries.root_cause: Upstream Google Cloud / Vertex AI capacity wave, Priority inference hitting its 0.3x rate limit, or an oversized single-turn prompt with `high`/`xhigh` thinking exceeding the server deadline.
entries.root_cause_zh: 上游云端容量波动、Priority 推理触及 0.3x 速率上限，或单轮超大上下文叠加 high/xhigh 深度思考导致服务端超时。
steps: Check live upstream status on ModelCraft (`/`) or `status.cloud.google.com` first to confirm whether it is a global outage.
If upstream is operational, shrink the turn payload: run `/compact`, split the task into smaller batches, and lower Thinking level to `low` or `medium`.
Use AGY v2.35.2+ mid-turn model switch to step down from Neon/Carbon to Hydrogen during regional capacity spikes.
If AGY hangs on `antigravity-unleash.goog`, restart the session and verify outbound HTTPS connectivity.
steps_zh: 先查看 ModelCraft 首页状态灯或 `status.cloud.google.com`，确认是否为上游全局故障。
若上游正常，先执行 `/compact` 瘦身上下文、拆分大任务，并将 Thinking 降至 `low` 或 `medium`。
高峰期容量拥堵时，可在 AGY 中切换至 Hydrogen 避开前沿模型拥堵队列。
若卡在 `antigravity-unleash.goog` 特性开关握手，重启会话并检查出站 HTTPS 连通性。

commands.label: Check Google Cloud Status incidents JSON directly
Verify TLS reachability to Gemini API endpoint

dont_dos: Do NOT disable exponential backoff in custom API scripts during 503 waves.
Do NOT re-send a 500k-token uncached prompt repeatedly when 504 occurs — split the request instead.
dont_dos_zh: 503 波动期间严禁关闭自定义脚本的指数退避重试。
遇到 504 超时不要原样重发 500k+ 超大上下文，应拆分请求。

history.note: Added Priority inference 0.3x note and AGY v2.35.2 mid-turn switch advice.

entries.title: MCP Server Shows Disconnected, EADDRINUSE, or Missing Env Vars
entries.title_zh: MCP 显示 Disconnected、端口占用或环境变量被剥离
symptoms: MCP server silently shows `Disconnected` in Antigravity or `gemini mcp list`.
Remote Streamable HTTP MCP fails because `url` (SSE) was configured instead of `httpUrl`.
MCP subprocess cannot see `*_KEY`, `*_TOKEN`, or `*_SECRET` environment variables.
entries.root_cause: Workspace directory is untrusted, JSON syntax or transport key (`url` vs `httpUrl`) is mismatched, port is already occupied (`EADDRINUSE`), or the CLI security sanitizer stripped `*KEY*`/`*TOKEN*`/`*SECRET*` env vars not explicitly declared in the server `env` block.
entries.root_cause_zh: 工作区目录尚未信任、配置文件语法或传输键名（SSE 用 `url`、Streamable HTTP 用 `httpUrl`）错配、端口被占用（EADDRINUSE），或 `*KEY*`/`*TOKEN*`/`*SECRET*` 环境变量未显式写入 MCP `env` 块而被安全机制剥离。
steps: Run `npx agycraft-mcp doctor` offline to lint `mcp_config.json` / `.gemini/settings.json`, check `url` vs `httpUrl`, and detect stripped env patterns.
Trust the current workspace directory (`gemini trust`) if running in a newly cloned repo.
Use `url` strictly for legacy SSE servers and `httpUrl` for Streamable HTTP MCP endpoints.
Explicitly declare required config keys or `${ENV_VAR}` references inside the MCP server's `env` block.
steps_zh: 先运行 `npx agycraft-mcp doctor` 离线检查 `mcp_config.json` / `.gemini/settings.json` 语法、`url` 与 `httpUrl` 错配及环境变量剥离风险。
在新克隆目录中执行 `gemini trust` 信任当前工作区。
确认远程传输键名：SSE 服务端用 `url`，Streamable HTTP 服务端用 `httpUrl`。
在 MCP Server 配置的 `env` 块中显式声明所需变量引用（如 `${ENV_VAR}`）。

commands.label: Run agycraft offline MCP & config doctor
List registered MCP servers and live connection states
Check occupied local port (replace 3000 with your MCP port)

dont_dos: Do NOT write raw API keys directly into git-tracked `.gemini/settings.json`.
Do NOT print `stdout` logs inside a stdio MCP server (use `stderr` only, otherwise JSON-RPC framing breaks).
dont_dos_zh: 严禁将明文 API Key 直接写入受 Git 追踪的 `.gemini/settings.json`。
Stdio MCP 服务端严禁向 `stdout` 打印普通日志（必须走 `stderr`，否则会破坏 JSON-RPC 帧）。

entries.title: UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY & Corporate Proxy Reset
error_patterns: unable to verify the first certificate
symptoms: Node-based CLI or MCP fails TLS handshake behind Zscaler, Netskope, or corporate MITM proxy.
Browser works normally, but `gemini` CLI and `npx agycraft-mcp` fail with certificate chain errors.
entries.root_cause: Node.js ships its own bundled CA store and ignores the OS corporate root CA unless `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` points to a readable PEM bundle, or `HTTPS_PROXY` is misconfigured.
entries.root_cause_zh: Node.js 默认使用内置 CA 证书库，会忽略系统企业根证书，必须通过 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 指定可读的 PEM 证书链并核对 `HTTPS_PROXY`。
steps: Export your organization's root CA certificate in PEM format (`.crt` / `.pem`).
Set `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` to the absolute path of that PEM file in your shell profile.
Verify `HTTPS_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY` formatting (include scheme `http://` or `https://`).
Confirm readability with `npx agycraft-mcp doctor`.
steps_zh: 导出企业根证书并确保为 Base64 PEM 格式（`.crt` / `.pem`）。
在 Shell 配置中设置 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 指向该证书的绝对路径。
检查 `HTTPS_PROXY` / `NO_PROXY` 格式（需包含 `http://` 或 `https://` 协议头）。
运行 `npx agycraft-mcp doctor` 验证证书路径可读性。

commands.label: Test TLS with Node native fetch

dont_dos: Do NOT set `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` globally — it disables TLS verification for all Node processes.
Do NOT point `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` to a DER binary file (it must be base64 PEM).
dont_dos_zh: 严禁全局设置 `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` 关闭证书校验。
不要将 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 指向二进制 DER 证书（必须为 PEM 文本格式）。

history.note: Verified Node 22 native fetch + NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS resolution.

entries.title: 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT: Structured Output Schema Too Complex / Deeply Nested
entries.title_zh: 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT：结构化输出 Schema 嵌套过深或状态过多
error_patterns: The specified schema produces a constraint that has too many states
symptoms: Gemini API rejects `responseSchema` with `400 INVALID_ARGUMENT` mentioning too many states or excessive nesting.
Large Zod/Pydantic unions (`anyOf` / recursive types) fail constrained decoding compilation.
entries.root_cause: Constrained decoding compiles the JSON Schema into a finite-state machine; deeply nested objects, recursive `$ref`, or wide `anyOf` unions exceed the state budget.
entries.root_cause_zh: 受限解码会将 JSON Schema 编译为有限状态机；嵌套过深、递归 `$ref` 或过宽的 `anyOf` 联合类型会超出状态机编译上限。
steps: Flatten nested objects to <= 4 levels and replace wide `anyOf` unions with a discriminated string enum + flat optional fields.
Remove unsupported keywords (recursive `$ref` or huge `enum` lists).
Use Interactions API `defer_loading: true` + `tool_search` (Nov 19, 2026) when attaching large tool schema libraries.
steps_zh: 将嵌套层级压平至 <= 4 层，并用枚举标识字段 + 扁平可选字段替代复杂的 `anyOf` 联合。
移除递归 `$ref` 或包含数百项的超大 `enum` 列表。
若因挂载大量工具导致 Schema 膨胀，可在 Interactions API 中开启 Tool Retrieval（`defer_loading: true` + `tool_search`）。

commands.label: Inspect JSON Schema nesting depth quickly with Node
commands.command: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const d=(o,n=0)=>o&&typeof o==="object"?Math.max(n,...Object.values(o).map(v=>d(v,n+1))):n; console.log("Max depth:", d(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8"))))' schema.json

entries.verify_command: node -e 'console.log("Validate flattened schema against Gemini API test prompt")'
dont_dos: Do NOT pass recursive TypeScript/Zod AST schemas directly into `responseSchema`.
Do NOT embed hundreds of dynamic IDs inside a schema `enum` array.
dont_dos_zh: 严禁将递归 TypeScript/Zod AST Schema 直接传入 `responseSchema`。
不要在 Schema 的 `enum` 数组中硬编码数百个动态 ID。

history.note: Updated with Interactions API Tool Retrieval (defer_loading) guidance.

entries.title: 400 Function Call / Function Response Turn Alignment Error
entries.title_zh: 400 Function Call / Function Response 轮次状态不对齐
error_patterns: Please ensure that function response turn comes immediately after a function call turn
symptoms: Multi-turn agent fails with `400 INVALID_ARGUMENT` stating function response turn must immediately follow function call turn.
Truncating conversation history mid-tool-loop leaves an orphaned `functionCall` or `functionResponse`.
Missing `thought_signature` when replaying thinking-enabled function call turns.
entries.root_cause: Gemini requires strict 1:1 pairing between model `functionCall` parts and the immediately following `functionResponse` parts (preserving `thought_signature` on thinking models). Naive history trimming breaks this invariant.
entries.root_cause_zh: Gemini 要求模型的 `functionCall` 轮次必须紧跟对应的 `functionResponse` 轮次（且思考模型须原样保留 `thought_signature`）。按条数机械截断历史记录会破坏该不变量。
steps: Ensure every `functionCall` turn is followed immediately by matching `functionResponse` parts with identical function names/IDs.
When compacting or sliding conversation history, always slice on complete user->model->tool->model boundaries.
Preserve raw model parts (including `thought_signature`) verbatim when sending multi-turn history back to Gemini 4 models.
steps_zh: 确保每个 `functionCall` 轮次后紧跟名称与 ID 完全匹配的 `functionResponse`。
裁剪或压缩会话历史时，必须按完整的 `user -> model -> tool -> model` 事务边界切分。
回传 Gemini 4 思考模型历史消息时，原样保留包含 `thought_signature` 在内的模型 Parts。

commands.label: Run agycraft doctor to check MCP tool schema & transcript loop health

dont_dos: Do NOT strip `thought_signature` fields when serializing Gemini 4 tool-calling turns.
Do NOT inject a `user` text message between a pending `functionCall` and its `functionResponse`.
dont_dos_zh: 序列化 Gemini 4 工具调用历史时严禁剥离 `thought_signature` 字段。
不要在未完成的 `functionCall` 与其 `functionResponse` 之间插入 `user` 文本消息。

history.note: Verified official aistudio.google.com/docs/function-calling link and zh translations.
